Limit[n=20]
  Sort[keys=lineitem.extended_price DESC, lineitem.id ASC]
    Project[lineitem.id AS id, lineitem.order_id AS order_id, lineitem.quantity AS quantity, lineitem.extended_price AS extended_price, lineitem.extended_price * (1.0 - lineitem.discount) AS discounted_price]
      Filter[lineitem.quantity > 10 AND lineitem.return_flag = 'R']
        Scan[lineitem]
